output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes in every location in October 2024, exactly when the board approved the Made Here redesign. The board's station time study projected that rise and it accepted it, with a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction, repeat visits, sales and margin did not fall afterward. The Pellston benchmark excluded scratch kitchens, so the 12-minute comparison is invalid. Riverside is a separate local failure: the saute/pasta cook left, the vacancy went unfilled, and group operations deferred transfer requests. Other locations are stable. Delgado's reason for leaving is disputed, so replacing the GM is unjustified. Frozen components cut food quality in the 2024 trial, and a ticket-time bonus invites KDS bumping, as the 2023 audit found. Fix Riverside's staffing and set the group baseline.
